lob_check_tracking_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a check tracking changes in Lob. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, description, date_created, tracking_events
